A '''Starfighter''' is a [[Starship]] subtype. Starfighters use maneuver (not armor) and usually need a pilot aboard to use power, maneuver, or hyperspeed.

Contrast [[Capital]] starships.

Premiere examples: [[X-wing]], [[Y-wing]], [[Millennium Falcon]], [[TIE Fighter]].
